node.statement: Apply the scalar conclusion to b=b_n and C=C_prod from node 1.2. Since e_sq, e_prod, and e_adj are positive universal thresholds and kappa,C_prod are finite universal constants, e_up=min(e_sq,e_prod,e_adj)>0 and C_up=kappa+C_prod<infinity are universal. Therefore ||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(Z)|| <= (1+C_up*e)||Z|| for every datum with e<=e_up, every n, and every Z.
